criteria.text: Every push to main can start install.yml regardless of changed paths: remove only push.paths, retain push.branches [main]; preserve pull_request.paths and jobs/permissions entirely; add workflow_dispatch.

Failing-first contract test re-derives trigger scope, proves an unrelated-path main push is accepted and PR path behaviour unchanged; exact-SHA checker still rejects a stale success; negative control fails when the push path filter is reinstated.
Focused tests, validate.py and the full suite (4 CI-equivalent shards, all exit 0) before commit; badges regenerated; clean commit, no trailers; manifest with intent and lighting lit; stop at BUILT.
